svg.title: Emerald Clockwork Dragon — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A recognizable four-limbed fantasy dragon with a reptilian head, long snout, horns, teeth, serpentine neck and tail, bat-like wings, claws, scales, and clockwork armor. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
